title: SkyrimNet Slave Auction
tagline: A secret slave auction under the stone: its staff, its buyers, its captives and the liberators know their part.
description: Prompts for skyrimnet_SlaveAuction.esp. Puts each role of the auction into the character's profile by faction: the receptionist with her rare drink, the cage guard, the auctioneer, the twelve buyers, the liberators, and the player and followers held as captives.
author: nightlantern-mods
